meta.source: Reserve Bank of India, DBIE (via the local Data Bank)
meta.revisionPolicy: Bank-wise figures are the banks' own returns as the RBI publishes them and are not revised once printed; the Outlook's latest March is provisional and is replaced by the next edition's figure. Mergers are disclosed on the acquirer, never joined.
meta.coverage: Liabilities and assets of urban co-operative banks as shares of the total, to March 2026
meta.note: RBI DBIE report 771, the Primary (Urban) Co-operative Banks' Outlook (statistical table), read from the local Data Bank mirror. Each edition prints the previous March as 'Final' and its own March as 'Provisional', both under the edition's date; read accordingly (a March takes the next edition's Final where one exists). The Data Bank's copy carries only the shares (per cent of total liabilities or assets); the amounts are in banks-ucb-balance-sheet, to March 2024.
